questions.question: Explain simple random sampling, stratified sampling, and systematic sampling. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain simple random sampling, stratified sampling, and systematic sampling. [U] /[CO1]
  • Simple random sampling: Every unit has equal chance (e.g., lottery method)
  • Stratified sampling: Population divided into groups (strata), samples taken from each
  • Systematic sampling: Select every kth unit (e.g., every 5th person)
  • Explanation – 4 marks
  • Example- 1 mark

questions.question: Explain Pie diagram. Represent the following data of pupulations of different mammals in a reserve forest in Tamil Nadu using a pie diagram. Deers - 105 , Monkeys - 65 , Fox - 50 , Leopards - 35 , Tigers - 20 , Others - 25. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain Pie diagram. Represent the following data of pupulations of different mammals in a reserve forest in
  • Tamil Nadu using a pie diagram.
  • Deers - 105 , Monkeys - 65 , Fox - 50 , Leopards - 35 , Tigers - 20 ,Others - 25. [A] / [CO3]
  • Circular chart showing proportions-Total = 360°,
  • Given data total = 105+65+50+35+20+25 = 300
  • Angles: • Deer = (105/300) ×360 = 126° • Monkeys = 78° • Fox = 60°• Leopards = 42° • Tigers = 24°
  • • Others = 30°
  • Calculation – 8 marks, Graph – 7 marks
